correctness.rationale: For the displayed squarefree degree-seven F over char 0 or p≥5, independently expanded the integral identities E·∇F=7F, U·∇F=AF, V·∇F=BF, det(E,U,V)=−3F, P×Q=−21∇F, and E×W=−3∇F−7(U×V), using separate exact SymPy algebra. Since 3 is invertible and generic tangencies to each squarefree irreducible component force divisibility by F, Cramer yields global free logarithmic basis E,U,V. For p≠7, primitive gradient and −21 unit give free AR basis degrees (3,3); in p=7 the Euler syzygy E and quintic W have cross product −3∇F and degrees (1,5). Coprime partial derivatives and Hilbert–Burch yield the displayed Hilbert series and projective gradient lengths 27,31. Characteristics 2,3 excluded; this is gradient ideal, not Tjurina ideal. Exact integral expansions corroborate critical nonstandard certificates; no finite-p extrapolation.

originality.rationale: Dimca–Pokora (2022) and their correction establish complex freeness of precisely this equilateral two-conic/three-line configuration and its corrected equations. The additional exact integral logarithmic determinant, its all-good-characteristic basis, and unique characteristic-seven Jacobian syzygy jump/length are distinct arithmetic assertions not implied by complex freeness alone. Nearby SCOPE/Resultary result concerns complex projective stabilizer and singular point geometry, not these modular syzygies.
